name: PreOrders for WooCommerce
author: SoftTent

sections.description:
SoftTent PreOrders adds a complete pre-order workflow for WooCommerce products that are not yet in stock.

This plugin supports:
* Pre-order support for simple and variable WooCommerce products.
* Configurable pre-order pricing flows, including full payment, partial payment, or free reservation options.
* Availability date handling with automatic status changes.
* Pre-order stock behavior controls for upcoming products.
* Customizable pre-order button text, icons, and before/after messages.
* Frontend display integration and cart handling for pre-order items.
* Shortcode support via [softtent_preorders].

Additional Information

For more information and updates, visit the official website https://softtent.com.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL-2.0-or-later License.

Source Code

The source code for this plugin can be found on GitHub. All development instructions are mentioned there.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload softtent-preorders to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Configure pre-order options from Dashboard > PreOrder WC.
sections.faq:
How to use this plugin

  • Go to Dashboard > PreOrder WC > Manage PreOrder.

Is WooCommerce required?

  • Yes. This plugin depends on WooCommerce and will not run without it.

Need Any Help?

  • Please mail us at contact@softtent.com
